summary: YPF S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the repurchase of a portion of its Class XXX Notes (YMCWO) in the open market between June 1-5, 2026, for Ps. 24,274,518,872.70 (~US$16.9M par) at an average price of 99.90% of nominal value. The notes were originally issued in July 2024 (US$185M) and April 2025 (US$204M) under a frequent issuer framework, maturing July 2026. This is a routine debt repurchase in the ordinary course, not a tender offer or special situation. No board recommendation, advisors, or structural changes are mentioned.
